page.purpose: The top bar's title on every page (24/28, 600); one per screen.

title-m.purpose: Card headings in a Faceplate, sheet and panel titles (17/24, 600).

card.purpose: The card title in a card head (15/20, 600; 16/22 from 1024).

hero.purpose: The one big number of a full-width hero card (Geist 300, 64; 88 from 1024).

num-l.purpose: The number of a wide card (Geist 300, 52; 64 from 1024).

num.purpose: The number of a tile (Geist 300, 44; 52 from 1024).

unit.purpose: The unit beside a number (15, 400, stone).

body-l.purpose: Plan rows, route-state lines, longer reading text (16/24).

read.purpose: The (i) panel's reading text (15/23; 62 characters at most; 16/24 from 1024).

meta.purpose: Mono caps for facts only: a date, a range, a unit, a state, a legend, a time (Geist Mono 500, 11/14, +0.08em; 12/16 from 1024).

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Every elevation token is none: depth is tone, hairline and grain.

shadows.name: field-focus-line
shadows.purpose: Doubles a focused field border to a 2px gold line without layout shift (not elevation).

shadows.name: menu-item-focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on menu rows (not elevation).

motion.name: dur-spring
motion.purpose: A sheet or panel opening (the spring).

motion.name: dur-glide
motion.purpose: The dock's thumb gliding to the pressed key (with --lm-ease-needle).

motion.name: dur-count
motion.purpose: A number counts up on first view (expo-out), 400 ms on an update.

motion.name: dur-draw
motion.purpose: A line draws left to right (clip reveal).

motion.name: dur-glow
motion.purpose: The card glow fades in once.

motion.name: dur-fill
motion.purpose: A track fills, a hypnogram wipes in.

motion.name: dur-tick
motion.purpose: AUDIT §4.5 names, aliases of the above.

motion.name: stagger-tick
motion.purpose: Ticks of a gauge light one after another.

motion.name: pulse-cycles
motion.purpose: The live end dot pulses twice, then stops (4.8 s, under WCAG 2.2.2's five seconds).

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: A sheet or panel leaving: ease-in, 220 ms.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion or Settings › Motion "reduce" every picture draws its final state at once; a state change gets a 100 ms cross-fade instead of a move.

breakpoints.name: sheet-fold
breakpoints.note: Container width of a sheet body: below it a four- or five-key bank folds into two columns.

material.name: grain
material.value: four 512px lossless tiles of fine film grain (per-pixel noise, long wavelengths cut): raw url(/brand/grain/vitals-grain.webp) and one per surface with its tone baked in: backdrop (72% #090909 over the grain), card (83% #1B1916), sidebar (83% #11100F); drawn at one image pixel per device pixel (512px / devicePixelRatio, set by src/app/grain.ts); the card grain is fixed to the viewport
material.purpose: Baked tone leaves each surface one CSS gradient, its wash (two stacked gradients dither into a woven grid); fixed card grain never resamples at a card edge between device pixels. Backdrop, card and desktop sidebar material only.

material.name: backdrop
material.value: radial-gradient(circle farthest-corner at 95% 0, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.055), transparent) over url(/brand/grain/vitals-grain-backdrop.webp) over #090909

material.name: card
material.value: radial-gradient(circle farthest-corner at 95% 0, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.035), transparent) over url(/brand/grain/vitals-grain-card.webp) fixed over #1B1916; 0.5px gold hairline; 20px radius; no shadow
material.purpose: The default card material (.lm-face, .lm-material, lm-material-card): the gold-wash card with no glow. GradientCard is this material.

material.name: domain-glow
material.value: one eased radial-gradient(in oklab ellipse <size> at <pos>, ...) of the domain's deep colour in five stops, alpha 1, .84, .50, .16, 0 (times the core alpha and --lm-glow-k) at 0, 20, 42, 64, 86 %, over the card grain (fixed to the viewport) over #1B1916; position / size / core alpha per domain: energy 50% 112% / 80% 62% / 0.78; heart 100% 100% / 115% 100% / 0.60; steps 0% 0% / 105% 80% / 0.55; sleep 100% 0% / 78% 105% / 0.62; body 50% 120% / 105% 70% / 0.60; recovery 100% 0% / 95% 85% / 0.58; food 100% 0% / 82% 105% / 0.58; videos 100% 100% / 100% 100% / 0.60; gold 0% 50% / 60% 150% / 0.34
material.purpose: A card opts into its domain with data-domain: one soft glow in the domain hue instead of the wash. Never animated (it fades in once over 900 ms through the registered --lm-glow-k), never behind small stone text, never on a banner or an inset well. Ivory text and marks are safe everywhere on it (5.1:1 at the brightest point of every glow).

material.name: frost
material.value: header: tintless blur 4 / 9 / 14px layers with masks, opacity over the first 80px of scroll; dock: one 14px tintless blur fading in over 24px; docked flow bar: the dock's blur, reaching 24px above the bar without taking room
material.purpose: Header, navigation dock and docked flow bar only.

brandMark.name: The plan ring
brandMark.description: An ivory ring left open at four o'clock over a hairline bezel, with a gold dot inside aimed at the opening (the next thing to do). Gauge's reading-ring family (thin ring on #090909, Ember gold and ivory, same geometry and safe zones) with the colour roles swapped: Gauge measures with a gold arc and an ivory dot on the ring; Vitals plans with an ivory ring and a gold dot inside.
brandMark.geometry: Shared with Gauge through design/brand/mark-geometry.json: 24-unit space, centre 12,12, outer edge 9.95, round caps, the same strokes, hairline and dot sizes in both marks. Standard: stroke 1.2 (ring r 9.35), opening 34 deg centred on 35 deg; bezel full circle 0.5 at 36 % ink; dot r 1.5 at 5.3 on the bisector. Medium (25-40 px): stroke 1.6, bezel 0.6, dot r 1.75, opening 40 deg. Small (24 px and under): stroke 2.0, dot r 2.0, opening 46 deg, no bezel. Themed/monochrome: stroke 1.4, bezel 0.35 at 50 %, dot r 1.7. Notification: ring edge 9.4, stroke 2.0, bezel 0.5 at 50 %, dot r 1.6.
brandMark.placement: Android layers at 3x (outer edge 29.85 dp inside the 33 dp safe radius); notification 24 dp white with 2 dp padding; rounded tiles at 0.37 of the side (0.4375 at 48 px and under); PWA maskable and monochrome at 0.34 inside the 40 % safe circle; in-app crop 2 2 20 20 (22 px sidebar, 88 px start screen).
brandMark.motion: Bezel still; ring draws on from 5 % in 500 ms; dot pops from 420 ms over 220 ms; reduced motion shows the still mark.
brandMark.source: design/brand/mark-geometry.json (shared with Gauge) read by design/brand/vitals-mark.py (writes every asset and src/components/brand/mark-geometry.ts)

components.name: Primary Key
components.description: The one gold pill per view for the primary action, with an arrow icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-key-primary">Run plan <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m13 6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-key-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); border-radius: var(--lm-key-radius, 24px); background: var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); color: var(--lm-signal-ink, #090909); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), filter 80ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.5, 1); } .ds-key-primary:hover { background: var(--lm-signal-hover, #F5CE82); border-color: var(--lm-signal-hover, #F5CE82); } .ds-key-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-key-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Key
components.description: The default secondary key: a neutral tile in the card's language.
components.css: .ds-key-outlined { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--lm-line-strong, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.4)); border-radius: var(--lm-control-radius, 10px); background: color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9) 6%); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-key-outlined:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9) 11%); } .ds-key-outlined:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-key-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Pill
components.description: The inline verb on a row ("Log"): a gold label on a 16 % gold tile.
components.css: .ds-key-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--lm-radius-sm, 8px); background: var(--lm-gold-action, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.16)); color: var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-key-action:hover { background: var(--lm-gold-soft, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.22)); } .ds-key-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Key Bank
components.description: A choice of two to six: a well with mono-caps segments; the selected one is the gold tile.
components.css: .ds-bank { display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(48px, 1fr); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-line, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.2)); border-radius: var(--lm-radius-track, 12px); background: var(--lm-well, #11100F); } .ds-bank__key { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--lm-ink-3, #AAA296); font-family: var(--lm-font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-bank__key:hover { color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); background: color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9) 4%); } .ds-bank__key[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--lm-select-on, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.15)); border-color: var(--lm-select-on-edge, rgb(227 191 120 / 0.4)); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-bank__key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A text field: a deep well, a strong hairline, a gold line on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field__label { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.125rem; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); } .ds-field__input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--lm-line-strong, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.4)); border-radius: var(--lm-control-radius, 10px); background: var(--lm-well, #11100F); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); }

components.name: Domain Chip
components.description: A pill tag with a 6 px dot in the domain colour; the words stay stone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--lm-ink-tile, rgb(245 241 233 / 0.06)); color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.005em; } .ds-chip__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lm-hue-energy, #E26B1B); }

components.name: Status Capsule
components.description: The header status as an icon key with no words; a gold dot appears while the state wants the person.
components.css: .ds-status { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-status:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, transparent, var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9) 6%); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-status__dot { position: absolute; top: 11px; right: 11px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lm-signal, #E3BF78); }

components.name: Plain Card
components.description: The default card: grained charcoal, a 0.5 px gold hairline, 20 px corners, no shadow, no glow.
components.html:
Where it sits

Your plan, weighed in at 83.1 kg this morning.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 18px; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-line, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.2)); border-radius: var(--lm-card-radius, 20px); background: var(--lm-card-bg, #1B1916); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); box-shadow: none; } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card__text { margin: 0; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.3125rem; }

components.name: Domain Card
components.description: A metric card in its domain: one soft eased glow in the hue (energy at the foot, sleep at the top right), ivory text and marks, small stone text kept off the core.
components.html:
Energy

1,096 kcal

of 2,595 today

Sleep

7 h 56

Goal met
components.css: .ds-glow-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-glow { min-height: 148px; padding: 18px; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-line, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.2)); border-radius: var(--lm-card-radius, 20px); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-glow--energy { background: radial-gradient(in oklab ellipse 80% 62% at 50% 112%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-energy-deep, #CB5A00) calc(0.78 * 100%), transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-energy-deep, #CB5A00) calc(0.78 * 84%), transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-energy-deep, #CB5A00) calc(0.78 * 50%), transparent) 42%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-energy-deep, #CB5A00) calc(0.78 * 16%), transparent) 64%, transparent 86%), var(--lm-card-bg, #1B1916); } .ds-glow--sleep { background: radial-gradient(in oklab ellipse 78% 105% at 100% 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-sleep-deep, #5737A7) calc(0.62 * 100%), transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-sleep-deep, #5737A7) calc(0.62 * 84%), transparent) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-sleep-deep, #5737A7) calc(0.62 * 50%), transparent) 42%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lm-hue-sleep-deep, #5737A7) calc(0.62 * 16%), transparent) 64%, transparent 86%), var(--lm-card-bg, #1B1916); } .ds-glow__title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-glow__num { margin: 18px 0 0; font-size: 2.75rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: proportional-nums; } .ds-glow__num span { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); } .ds-glow__meta { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: var(--lm-font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); }

components.name: Card Head with (i)
components.description: The head of a metric card: the domain icon, the title, and the (i) key (a 28 px circle with a 48 px hit area) that opens the explanation.
components.html: Energy
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-head__ic { flex: none; color: var(--lm-hue-energy, #E26B1B); } .ds-head__title { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-info { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-info-key-edge, rgb(245 241 233 / 0.14)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--lm-info-key-bg, rgb(245 241 233 / 0.07)); color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), transform 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-info::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -10px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-info:hover { background: var(--lm-info-key-bg-hover, rgb(245 241 233 / 0.13)); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-info:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-info:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Number
components.description: The one hero number of a card: Geist 300, proportional figures, the unit small and muted beside it, the likely range in mono caps underneath.
components.css: .ds-hero { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-hero__line { font-size: 4rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: proportional-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hero__unit { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); } .ds-hero__range { font-family: var(--lm-font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); }

components.name: Mono Meta
components.description: The fact line: mono caps for a date, a range, a unit, a state or a time; items are joined by a middle dot. Never above a heading except the top bar's date.
components.css: .ds-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; font-family: var(--lm-font-mono, "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); } .ds-meta span + span::before { content: "\00b7"; margin-inline: 0.6em; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Dotted Track
components.description: A progress track drawn in dots (8 px pitch): lit dots in ivory, the unlit remainder in the domain dim, a thumb at the value and a notch at the goal.
components.css: .ds-track { position: relative; width: 240px; height: 14px; --ds-dim: var(--lm-hue-food-dim, #38462B); } .ds-track__dots, .ds-track__lit { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; height: 6px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 4px 3px, var(--ds-dim) 1.7px, transparent 2.1px); background-size: 8px 6px; background-repeat: repeat-x; width: 240px; } .ds-track__lit { width: 96px; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 4px 3px, var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9) 1.7px, transparent 2.1px); } .ds-track__thumb { position: absolute; left: 96px; top: 0; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: -7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); border: 2px solid var(--lm-face, #1B1916); box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: A banner: the card material with no glow, a 14 px corner, a title, one stone line and at most one action.
components.html:
Plan paused

Resume it from Plan details when you are ready.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-line, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.2)); border-radius: var(--lm-radius-field, 14px); background: var(--lm-card-bg, #1B1916); color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); font-family: var(--lm-font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-notice__mark { flex: none; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--lm-caution-mark, #E3BF78); } .ds-notice__title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.3125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-notice__body { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.3125rem; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); }

components.name: Navigation Dock
components.description: The phone dock: a floating pill of 56 x 48 keys; the current one is an ivory capsule with a dark icon and label.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; height: var(--lm-nav-pill-h, 64px); padding: 8px 10px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 0.5px solid var(--lm-line, rgb(198 171 124 / 0.2)); border-radius: var(--lm-nav-pill-radius, 36px); background: var(--lm-nav-pill-bg, rgb(27 25 22 / 0.94)); } .ds-dock__key { display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--lm-nav-key-w, 56px); height: var(--lm-nav-key-h, 48px); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--lm-ink-2, #C3BCB0); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 280ms var(--lm-ease-needle, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1)), color 140ms var(--lm-ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-dock__key:hover { color: var(--lm-ink, #F5F1E9); } .ds-dock__key[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--lm-nav-on-bg, #F5F1E9); color: var(--lm-nav-on-fg, #090909); } .ds-dock__key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lm-focus, #E3BF78); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Row
components.description: A desktop sidebar row: 44 px tall, 14 px corners; the current row is an ivory tint, not a gold slab.
components.html:

narrative.overview:
Vitals is a precise instrument that is also humane, and its surface reads that way: a near-black, finely grained backdrop with a faint warm-gold wash from the top right, charcoal cards that carry the same grain, ivory text, stone secondary text and one warm gold that only ever means something. A screen is one header, one overflow menu, content and a floating dock. It is read in seconds on a phone (open, see today and the next thing, log it in one tap, leave) and explored for longer at a laptop, so density is calm but not sparse: 12 px between cards (16 px from 1024 px) and inside them, tabular numerals wherever a value changes in place so values never jitter, and big numbers set light and proportional.

The look is the owner's reference, Lumen Health "Ember", carried over to the web and refined in r071 by the two references the owner chose (see Revision r071): hairline gold borders drawn at 0.5 px, 20 px card corners, one gold pill for the primary key and rounded-rectangle controls otherwise, Geist for text and numerals with Geist Mono caps for facts, one soft glow in a card's domain hue where a card opts in, tintless frosted chrome. The system is flat. Depth is tone, hairline and grain, never shadow; a glow is colour inside a card, not depth. Vitals is dark only; there is one palette on `:root`, no light theme and no theme switch. The product refuses the stacked-bars, captioned-everything dashboard: no explainer subtext a label already says, nothing injected between content sections, no persistent bar that changes meaning per page.

This file supersedes `design/DESIGN_DIRECTION.md` and `design/REVIEW_FINDINGS.md`, which describe the retired v1 Ulm/Braun world (mineral-grey chassis, white faceplates, Archivo in three widths, a light theme, yellow-dot key banks). Nothing from that world is inherited. Token values live in `design/tokens.css` (master) and its byte-identical copy `src/styles/tokens.css`; `src/styles/tailwind-theme.css` maps them into Tailwind v4 and resets every default Tailwind colour, radius and shadow so an off-system value cannot be typed.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black grained backdrop (fixed, never scrolls) with a 5.5 % gold radial wash at the top right.
Charcoal grained cards, 0.5 px gold hairline, 20 px corners, no shadow, never nested; a card may opt into one soft glow in its domain hue.
Gold for the primary action, the selection and the moment; data wears one of eight domain hues; ivory marks where you are.

Geist for text, titles and numerals, Geist Mono caps for facts; tabular numerals on the root, big numbers light (300) and proportional; weights 300 (numerals of 36 px and up) / 400 / 500 / 600, nothing heavier.
A gold pill for the primary key and rounded rectangles for every other control; one floating five-key dock on phones, a collapsible sidebar on desktop.
One top bar on every page; tintless frost on the top bar and the dock, nowhere else.

rules.name: The Gold Means Something Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the action, the selection and the moment; data wears its domain. It is never body text, never a data series and never a surface fill stronger than an 18 % wash. If a gold element does none of those jobs (a primary key, a selected thing, "now" or an attention dot, focus, the brand), it is wrong. Ivory marks where you are (the dock, the sidebar): gold is what you can do or chose, ivory is where you are. (Superseded by r071: "a state or a data trace".)

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: The eight domain hues are validated for wheel neighbours only (all pairs fail the colour-vision gates) and the three warm category slots stay desaturated, so identity is never colour alone: series carry visible labels or legends, composite series add a dash pattern, an ordinal step prints its value, severity always ships with an icon and a label, evidence grades with a letter and pips.

rules.name: The Quiet Severity Rule
rules.body: Info and ok are neutrals, caution is gold, danger is muted rose. Colour sits on the mark (the icon, the dot), never on a banner fill, a heading or a side stripe.

rules.name: The Weights Rule
rules.body: Body is 400, labels, keys and mono meta 500, titles and values 600, and 300 exists only for numerals of 36 px and up. Nothing is heavier than 600: `fonts.css` declares Geist at 300–600 and Geist Mono at 400–600, so a bold request (`<b>`, `<strong>`, 700) lands on 600, and no stylesheet asks for 350 or 550. (Replaces the Three Weights Rule of 350 / 400 / 500 with a 550 ceiling, and r068's floors of Inter at 400 and Figtree at 600.)

rules.name: The Numerals Rule
rules.body: Tabular numerals are set on the root and inherited, so a value that changes never shifts its neighbours. The exception is display size: hero, wide and tile numbers (64 / 52 / 44 px) are proportional (`.lm-num-prop`), because tabular figures loosen "1,096" and "11:11" at that size. Whatever changes in place, aligns in a column or reads as a clock (legend values, tables, ticks, the 36 px Next-up time) stays tabular. During a count-up the final width is reserved, so the unit beside the number never moves. (Replaces the Tabular Everything Rule.)

rules.name: The Fact Line Rule
rules.body: A line beside a heading exists only if it states a fact: a number, a date, a state. There are no eyebrows or kickers and no explanatory subtitles. Facts are set in mono caps (Geist Mono 500, UPPERCASE, +0.08em): a date, a range, a unit, a state, a legend label, a time, a tick. That is the only uppercase text in the product; everything else is sentence case. A mono line never sits above a heading as a kicker, with one exception chosen by the owner (r071, SPEC Q4, "like the references"): the top bar draws the page's date, or its one fact, above the title.

rules.name: The One Header Rule
rules.body: One top bar, one ⋯, one banner slot per screen. No bar at the foot beside the navigation, no bar above the navigation, no persistent bar whose meaning changes per page. The one thing that docks at the foot is a phone flow's step keys, and only in the navigation pill's place on a screen that has no pill.

rules.name: The One Bar Height Rule
rules.body: Every control in the header's title row and in the action row is exactly one height: 36 px for a fine pointer, 44 px for a coarse one. That includes a key bank: its track is the bar height and its segments fill it (12 px side padding, 14 px labels, still mono caps). The bar's own keys (the sidebar key, Back and ⋯) are 48 px round targets with 24 px icons, and the status icons are 48 px round targets with 22 px icons; the bar's tabs and progress rows keep the components' own sizes.

rules.name: The No Nested Cards Rule
rules.body: A card never holds another card. A list of similar items becomes rows inside one card.

rules.name: The Flat Material Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows or bevel. A pressed key changes its background or brightness, never its depth. (Superseded in part by r071: the clause "or glow" is retired. A card may carry one domain glow inside its own colour; it is colour, not depth, it never reaches outside the card and it is never animated. The live endpoint's two rings are marks, not surfaces: they pulse twice, 4.8 s, then stop.)

rules.name: The Grain Twice Rule
rules.body: Grain and the gold wash appear on two surfaces: the page backdrop and the card material. The desktop sidebar takes the grain without the wash, through 83 % bg-2. A card that opts into a domain swaps its wash for ONE glow gradient, never both: no card carries two gradient layers. (Superseded in part by r071: "no other element carries a texture or a gradient" now reads: nothing but the card's own glow adds a gradient inside a card, and no other element carries a texture or a gradient.)

rules.name: The Tintless Frost Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur belongs to the top bar, the dock and the docked toolbar, with no tint and no fill. Cards, sheets and menus are never frosted.

rules.name: The One Way Out Rule
rules.body: An overlay draws exactly one way out: Cancel when it commits, ✕ when it does not. The commit is the filled primary key the panel draws (a phone sheet's foot, a side panel's head), or the verb at a dialog's foot, and never a key in a sheet's body.

dos: **Do** build every surface from the tokens (`var(--lm-*)` or the Tailwind roles mapped from them); edit `design/tokens.css` and copy it to `src/styles/tokens.css`.

**Do** give cards the grained card material, a 0.5 px gold hairline and 20 px corners, with 12 px between cards (16 px from 1024 px) and 18 px (24 px from 1024 px) inside; opt a card into its domain glow with `data-domain`, and nowhere else.

**Do** make the primary key a gold pill and every other control a rounded rectangle in the card's language, and size every control in the header row and the action row to the bar height (36 px fine pointer, 44 px coarse).
**Do** keep gold for the action, the selection and the moment, and ivory for where you are; selected things take the gold wash, the 40 % gold edge and ivory text, and data wears its domain hue.

**Do** set numbers tabular with the unit inline, smaller and in stone (hero, wide and tile numbers are light and proportional), and give every chart series, severity and grade a label, icon, pip or dash in addition to its colour.
**Do** use 400 for body, 500 for labels, keys and mono meta, 600 for titles and values, and 300 only for numerals of 36 px and up.
**Do** set facts in mono caps (a date, a range, a unit, a state, a legend label, a time, a tick) and everything else in sentence case.

**Do** let motion report state: 140 ms for hover and selection, 200 ms for panels, a 320 ms spring in and 220 ms out for sheets and side panels, 280 ms with one damped overshoot for the dock's thumb, 420 ms for needles and readouts; count a number up, sweep a gauge, draw a line and grow bars once, when 20 % in view; and render the final state at once under reduced motion, with overlays cross-fading in 100 ms.

**Do** give every sheet and side panel the one grammar: title · Cancel with a filled commit key (foot on phones, head on desktop) when it commits, title · ✕ when it does not. A dialog that asks for a decision ends in Cancel · verb at its foot and shows no ✕.
**Do** open a tapped object row's sheet (title · ✕, one fact line, the answer bank, then text keys) and reuse the one meal sheet wherever a meal row appears.
**Do** keep a key bank on one row: segments at least their label's width (48 px minimum), the bar height inside a bar, scrolling only when the labels themselves cannot fit.
**Do** dock a phone flow's step keys on the navigation pill's material in the pill's place, at the bar height, when the screen has no navigation pill.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, bevels or blur to cards, sheets or menus; depth is tone, hairline and grain. A card's one domain glow is the only glow, and only inside the card.

**Don't** put grain or gradients on anything except the page backdrop, the card material (its wash, or its one domain glow) and (grain only) the desktop sidebar; never two gradient layers on one card, never a glow behind small text, never an animated gradient.
**Don't** use gold for body text, decoration, a data series or a fill stronger than an 18 % wash.
**Don't** nest a card inside a card.
**Don't** add a second top bar, a second ⋯, a persistent bottom bar or a bar above the navigation pill; at most one banner, directly under the top bar.
**Don't** write eyebrows, kickers or explanatory subtitles; a line beside a heading states a fact or does not exist.

**Don't** set text in uppercase except the mono caps role for facts, don't put a mono line above a heading as a kicker (the top bar's date line is the one exception), and don't use a weight above 600 or a light weight under 36 px.
**Don't** colour banners, headings or side stripes by severity; colour sits on the mark only.
**Don't** add a light theme, a theme switch or a `prefers-color-scheme` branch; Vitals is dark only.
**Don't** generate new data hues; a ninth series reuses a category hue with a dash pattern and marker shape.

**Don't** plot the eight domain hues together (all pairs fail the colour-vision gates; wheel neighbours only) or let a domain solid be a text colour. (This replaces the r068 Don't "put a cool hue in any data palette".)
**Don't** put a ✕ beside a Cancel, a commit key in a sheet's body or footer, or a full-width Save anywhere in a sheet.
**Don't** put words in the header's status or show more than two status icons; the words are the icon's name and tooltip, and the rest go into the ⋯.
**Don't** wrap a segment label, drop a segment to a second row or shrink a segment below its label.
**Don't** fill the setup progress row partially, number it, name its segments or dash them; a step is current, finished or not yet.
**Don't** float the docked flow bar's keys on frost alone; they always sit on the solid pill.
